citations.claim: NS still green at 150, well past max_green 90
NS yellow at 154, would need to last to 157 to meet 6s
First violation at 155: yellow lasted 4s on approach 0, limit 6, now all-red

counterfactual.change: Changed actuated true->false; fixed-time enforces green limit and full 6s yellow, removing violation

explanation: Actuated controller fails to enforce max_green_seconds. NS stays green from step 0 through 150 (>90s max). When it finally gaps out at 151, yellow runs only 4s (151-154) before all-red at 155, violating required yellow_seconds=6. Fixed-time mode with same timings does not violate.
vision_note: Steps 152-154 show the NS approaches displaying yellow (yellow dots) while EW remains red, then step 155 shows all approaches red. The yellow phase is visibly only 3-4 seconds before the all-red clearance, indicating a truncated yellow.
